# LeakSanitizer suppressions for Linux CI (ADR 0020). Only third-party Vulkan components belong
# here; leaks in ezMU code must never be suppressed.

# Uninstrumented Vulkan libraries loaded at runtime, when their frames can be symbolized.
leak:libvulkan.so
leak:libvulkan_lvp.so
leak:libgallium
leak:libLLVM
leak:libVkLayer_khronos_validation.so

# One-time allocations made by the loader/driver while initializing (seen with Mesa lavapipe).
# The driver library is unloaded before LSan reports, so its frames show as <unknown module>;
# these ezMU wrappers (engine/rhi/src/vulkan.cpp) contain nothing but the Vulkan call.
leak:ezmu::rhi::detail::driverCreateInstance
leak:ezmu::rhi::detail::driverEnumeratePhysicalDevices
